steps.name: Open builder
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Itinerary**. Use **Build Itinerary** / **Edit Itinerary**.
steps.expect: The itinerary builder opens on **Set Visit Date**.

steps.name: Visit date and distant animals
steps.do: On **Set Visit Date**, pick a date on the Zoomobile summer route. On **Add Animals**, add **African Lion** and **Grizzly Bear**. Do not add Masai Giraffe or Grevy's Zebra.
steps.expect: **African Lion** and **Grizzly Bear** are selected. Giraffe and zebra are not.

steps.name: Add Zoomobile as transportation
steps.do: Skip Zoomobile on **Add Attractions**. On **Add Transportation**, select **Zoomobile**, confirm **Add as Transportation?**, then **Finish**.
steps.expect: The itinerary saves. List shows lion and bear, not giraffe or zebra. Finish alone does not add ride-viewable animals.

steps.name: Rebuild to place rides
steps.do: Open **Day Planner View** and click **Rebuild schedule**.
steps.expect: Feedback such as **Schedule rebuilt** appears. At least one Zoomobile transit ride is on the timeline.

steps.name: List hides ride animals
steps.do: Open **List View** and check **Animals**. Look for **Grevy's Zebra** (Savanna Grasslands) and **Masai Giraffe** (Outdoor).
steps.expect: Neither appears on List. They also do not appear under Day Planner **Scheduled Items** or **Unscheduled Items**.

steps.name: Day Planner hides ride-only animals
steps.do: Open **Day Planner View** and check **Unscheduled Items** and the timed pills.
steps.expect: Giraffe and zebra do not appear as unscheduled rows or as their own timed pills. The Zoomobile ride pill remains.

steps.name: Lime ring and planned-via alert
steps.do: On the itinerary map, click the giraffe (or zebra) marker.
steps.expect: The marker has a lime ring. The animal alert banner says **This animal is only planned via the Zoomobile on your itinerary.**

steps.name: Guest-added giraffe stays normal
steps.do: Edit the itinerary, add **Masai Giraffe** / Africa Savanna / Outdoor on **Add Animals**, **Finish**, then **Rebuild schedule** again. Click the giraffe marker.
steps.expect: Giraffe remains on List as a normal animal (schedule/remove still available if untimed). The lime ring and planned-via alert are gone.

steps.name: Removing Zoomobile drops ride-only zebra
steps.expect: **Grevy's Zebra** (ride-only) leaves the map. Guest-added giraffe stays.
